summary: Kinross Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release that announces the voting results from its Annual Shareholder Meeting held on April 30, 2026. The release details the re-election of directors with overwhelming approval (99.91% for J. Paul Rollinson, 98.53% for George V. Albino) and advisory votes on executive compensation (92.98% for) and appointment of auditors (90.49% for). This is a routine post-meeting report of a non-U.S. issuer using Form 40-F; no special situation event occurred.
